title: Case Study: Helicopter Racing League — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Cloud CDN Video Ingress Failure & Multi-Region Fallback: primary video transcoder facility loses power; traffic fails over to backup regional transcoder with zero stream interruption.
routing_rationale: Live sports broadcasting demands zero buffering; dual-region active-active transcoding clusters paired with Cloud CDN origin failover eliminate viewer blackouts.

nodes.label: Primary Transcoder (Failed)
nodes.detail: Datacenter power glitch abruptly knocks out primary encoding cluster.

nodes.label: Cloud CDN Origin Failover
nodes.detail: Detects HTTP 502 from primary origin; automatically shifts requests to secondary origin.

nodes.label: Secondary Transcoder (Active)
nodes.detail: Warm standby transcoder picks up stream chunk encoding in < 2 seconds.

nodes.label: Global Viewers (Zero Buffering)
nodes.detail: Edge cache buffers absorb 2-second switchover; zero dropped frames for 10M viewers.

steps.title: Automated Origin Health Check Detection
steps.action: Cloud CDN detects primary origin failure and switches to secondary origin automatically.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates single point of failure in video distribution pipeline.

steps.title: Zero-Buffer Viewer Experience
steps.action: Secondary origin continues segment stream; player video buffer plays through transition.
steps.why_traversal: Protects broadcast integrity and sponsor advertising revenue.

scenarios.label: Long Health Check Timeout Causes Player Buffering
scenarios.root_cause: Origin timeout set to 15 seconds; player 3-second buffer emptied before switch occurred.
scenarios.diverted_path: Viewers saw spinning loading wheel for 12 seconds.
scenarios.blast_radius: Viewer complaints during final race lap.
scenarios.recovery: Tune Cloud CDN origin timeout to 2 seconds with 2 consecutive retry limits.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Simulates Cloud CDN Video Ingress Failure & Multi-Region Fallback: primary video transcoder facility loses power; traffic fails over to backup regional transcoder with zero stream interruption.
